router (gate fp32, plan, pre/post, top-k inside the moe range)
dense projections (fp8 GEMV outside moe: q/kv/o + engram/compressor/indexer linears)
head (fixed-order fp32 / bf16-stored head, cuBLAS head)
fp8 GEMV, call site not resolvable (no NVTX role)
glue: norms + mHC (hc_norm, norm_row, sinkhorn, hc_post, mixes)
glue: indexer top-k/sort (outside the moe range)
torch top-k/sort, router vs indexer not resolvable (no NVTX role)
glue: torch residual (elementwise, reduce, cat, index, cub, asserts)
routed expert bytes from HBM per verify step
cold expert bytes over C2C per verify step
cold share of routed unique-expert calls
cold-expert work exposed on GB300 per step
